## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Spatial
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Spatial query interfaces
//  - Spatial index interfaces

//==
// # Spatial query interfaces
//
// What a piece of geometry can be asked: cast a ray at it, ask it for its
// closest point, or search its points for the k nearest. The derived
// functionality — including the convenience overloads that assemble the query
// records — lives in `spatial-structures.library.plato`.

// Anything a 2D ray can be cast against.
interface IRaycast2D
{
    Raycast(x: Self, query: RayQuery2D): RayHit2D;
}

// Anything a 3D ray can be cast against.
interface IRaycast3D
{
    Raycast(x: Self, query: RayQuery3D): RayHit3D;
}

// Anything that can report its closest point to a 2D query point.
interface IClosestPoint2D
{
    ClosestPoint(x: Self, point: Point2D): ClosestPointResult2D;
}

// Anything that can report its closest point to a 3D query point.
interface IClosestPoint3D
{
    ClosestPoint(x: Self, point: Point3D): ClosestPointResult3D;
}

// Anything that can answer k-nearest-neighbor searches over 2D points.
interface INearestNeighbor2D
{
    FindNearest(x: Self, query: KNearestQuery2D): NearestNeighbors;
}

// Anything that can answer k-nearest-neighbor searches over 3D points.
interface INearestNeighbor3D
{
    FindNearest(x: Self, query: KNearestQuery3D): NearestNeighbors;
}

//==
// # Spatial index interfaces
//
// The broad-phase query surface every acceleration structure implements: an
// item count and a bounds query returning candidate indices, which may include
// false positives. The derived functionality lives in
// `spatial-structures.library.plato`.

// A queryable acceleration structure over indexed 2D primitives
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spatial_database). Candidate results are
// indices into the caller's primitive list and may include false positives
// (exact tests are the caller's second phase).
interface ISpatialIndex2D
{
    ItemCount(x: Self): Integer;
    CandidatesInBounds(x: Self, bounds: Bounds2D): Array<ItemIndex>;
}

// A queryable acceleration structure over indexed 3D primitives. Candidate
// results are indices into the caller's primitive list and may include
// false positives (exact tests are the caller's second phase).
interface ISpatialIndex3D
{
    ItemCount(x: Self): Integer;
    CandidatesInBounds(x: Self, bounds: Bounds3D): Array<ItemIndex>;
}
```
